item.text:
Reconstructed all 21 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and verified that they align line by line with the Roman transcription in `romanLyrics`. Updated the title and script metadata, removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag, and preserved the two `Dohra` breaks as blank lines.

The Roman readings `sand` and `Moazma` are ambiguous. I rendered them as سند and معظمہ.
